pages.text: A JSON config file at $(thing)config/betterhorses-common.json$() lets you toggle whole subsystems without removing the mod. Server admins use this to shape what's available on a given world.

pages.title: What You Can Toggle
pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Stabilizers$() — wing-deployed gliding.$(li)$(thing)Medkits$() — auto-heal on low health.$(li)$(thing)Hitchposts$() — tethering blocks.$(li)$(thing)Hooves$() — frost-walker + step-up + fall damage perks.$(li)$(thing)Horse Exclusivity$() — owner-only riding.$(li)$(thing)Multi-riding$() — two passengers on one horse.

pages.title: Dummy Mode
pages.text: Items disabled in the config don't disappear — they switch to $(thing)dummy mode$() and stay craftable as $(thing)decorative models$() only. Build a ghost-stable for show without anything actually firing off in the world.
